evidence: Matches the 'Scripts and tools' label and modifies contrib/verify-binaries/verify.py.
rationale: Fixes a security-critical verification bug where untrusted signatures from local keyrings satisfied the trusted signature threshold. As noted in the description, 'verify_shasums_signature calculated trusted signatures as len(good_trusted) + len(good_untrusted)' and counted revoked keys, undermining release verification integrity.
